text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: cache-integrity alert affecting prefix/KV cache (prod). Paging emma (oncall) and raj (sre). Incident created INC-2026-0423

emma: I'm awake, looking now. any immediate customer reports?

raj: seeing spike in correctness errors for reranking and chat_context endpoints. 500s up ~3x. Logs show prefix cache misses returning stale vectors.

raj: sample log: `2026-04-23T11:02:12Z ERROR prefix_cache: key=usr:12345/pfx mismatch expected_hash=0x7a3 got=0x1f2`

emma: ack. do we need to page eng-runtime? @taylor can you weigh in on bypassing cache for affected models?

taylor: on it. quick root-cause guess: normalization change in last rollout w/inference v3 that changed prefix serialization -> cache keys invalid for mixed versions. correctness issue, not just perf.

taylor: mitigation plan: 1) split traffic 90/10 to route new traffic to a no-cache variant, 2) temporary TTL reduction, 3) add cache-bypass for keys failing checksum. will do 1 and 3 now.

emma: go for split, keep me posted. also reduce burst quota for anonymous/free-tier to limit noise.

raj: applying quota throttle for free-tier keys: `redwoodctl quotas update --scope=free --rate=10r/s --burst=20`

deploy-bot: config change queued by raj: quotas:update free-tier -> 10r/s. Change will roll out in 30s.

taylor: running traffic-split command:
```
redwoodctl route split --selector=\"model:llama-infer-v3\" --variant=no-cache-v3 --percent=10 --env=prod
```

emma: confirm when split is live. also add a short customer-facing blurb for CS.

taylor: split active at 11:06Z. verifying error rate on no-cache path... so far new path errors ~0.8%, old path errors ~4.1%. Good sign.

raj: enabling cache bypass for checksum-failed keys via quick rule:
```
redwoodctl config set prefix_cache.bypass_on_checksum_fail=true --env=prod
```

deploy-bot: config change applied.

maria: CS here. drafting notice: "We are investigating an issue affecting some cached responses. Some customers may see stale results; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll update in 30 minutes." Want me to hit major accounts?

emma: yes, please notify top-five accounts and support channels. include that we have a temporary rate limit to reduce noise.

raj: monitoring metrics: errors down 60% since split + bypass. 500s trending toward baseline. latency slightly up on no-cache path (~12ms p95).

emma: good. next step: decide whether to fully disable prefix cache for mixed-model traffic or roll back the normalization change. prefer targeted patch.

taylor: I can push a targeted rollback to the normalization code in 15m and run canary. but that requires a minor model-serving restart on dedicated nodes. request approval for 2-minute advisory window.

emma: approve. coordinate with night SRE to avoid coincident deploys.

raj: running post-mitigation checks: data-consistency job for last 24h shows ~0.02% inconsistent responses. will run full sweep overnight.

deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-0423 updated: mitigations applied (traffic-split, cache-bypass, quota throttle).

maria: sent status update to affected accounts and posted to #support-updates.

taylor: starting rollback canary now on 5 nodes. command:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=inference-normalizer --to=rev-2026-04-20 --canary=5
```

emma: if canary looks good, schedule gradual rollout. keep me posted every 10m. handing page to raj for next 30m while I take a quick break.

raj: taking over incident. @taylor please ping when canary passes. I'll keep watching the dashboards and handle exec comms.

raj: 11:24Z canary looks stable; errors on canary nodes are within baseline. starting 25% rollout.

taylor: full rollout completed at 11:38Z. normalization rollback in prod. reverting traffic-split and disabling bypass after propagation.

raj: reverting traffic-split:
```
redwoodctl route split --selector=\"model:llama-infer-v3\" --variant=no-cache-v3 --percent=0 --env=prod
```

raj: disabling bypass: `redwoodctl config set prefix_cache.bypass_on_checksum_fail=false --env=prod`

deploy-bot: config changes applied.

emma: taking back the incident. monitoring for 1h. please collate logs and open a postmortem. Owner: taylor. Severity: P2 (was P1 during the peak). Customer impact: intermittent stale results for a subset of requests; major accounts notified.

maria: will follow up with customers for post-incident notes.

taylor: noted. I'll prepare a postmortem with root cause (normalization change -> cache key mismatch), mitigation timeline, and planned fixes (add key-versioning, stronger canaries, automated checksum alerting).

raj: closing pager. moving to watch state. :white_check_mark:

emma: thanks team. great coordination. end of thread.
